The plot illustrates the change in sharpness composition over the course of training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6400, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 1600. The y-axis is labeled "Sharpness composition" and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁻³ to 10⁰. A single blue line is displayed with a solid line style and no markers. This line starts at approximately 10⁻² at the beginning of the x-axis (0 steps) and increases to approximately 10⁻¹ at 6400 steps. An orange line is also shown with a solid line style and no markers. This line begins near 10⁻³, declines to approximately 10⁻⁴ at 320 steps, increases to approximately 10⁻¹ at 4800 steps, and then stabilizes, reaching approximately 10⁻¹ at 6400 steps.
